overview_description.description: Saratoga Energy Research Partners is developing an inexpensive production process to synthesize graphite from CO2. Saratoga’s technology electrochemically separates CO2 into oxygen and graphitic carbon, an essential material in lithium-ion batteries. Graphite produced by the Saratoga process is well suited for fast-charging electric vehicles, grid storage, and a broad spectrum of other energy and industrial applications.

product.name: Graphite Anode Material
product.description: A process developed by Saratoga Energy converts carbon dioxide into graphite anode material for lithium-ion batteries, significantly reducing production costs and time.

product.name: Carbon Nanotubes
product.description: Saratoga Energy's patented process produces carbon nanotubes from carbon dioxide, intended for use in enhancing battery performance and reducing charging times.

product.name: Graphite for Carbon Composites
product.description: Graphite produced through Saratoga Energy's process can be used in high performance plastics to improve thermal and electrical conductivity, and impact resistance.

product.name: Graphite for Concrete
product.description: Custom formulations of Saratoga Energy’s graphite improve concrete's abrasion resistance and compressive strength, extending the service life of structures.
